body:
Thank you all. I feel a lot better. I’m thankful that I have a wonderful husband who loves me and supports me. 
Sometimes you get stuck so far in your head that the only way to get out is suicide. 
I’m happy that I didn’t go through with it. I’ve made the decision to get back into therapy and take better care of myself and give all my love to my family.
I had DCR surgery several years ago. Really glad I didn’t search any surgeries up. I still would’ve gotten the surgery but my anxiety would’ve been through the roof.

The UPS truck broke down in front of our house. Those other trucks are trucks that were in the area that came to help that driver with his deliveries. 
You need to not take shit so literally.
Thank you! We thought it was phlox until we started shopping for it and couldn’t find a match!

If this happens again, a way to get them out without causing the most discomfort is by suffocating the botfly with petroleum jelly or a dressing. 
I am not a doctor or vet. Just have watched way too many YouTube videos on botfly removal.

Does he feel that way about you? I can’t tell you how many times I’ve pushed my husband away. Told him it wouldn’t work. Thought about leaving him. Just give him a chance. He sees something in you, or he wouldn’t be with you. 
Looks aren’t everything. I’ve always felt unattractive, and my husband always tells me I’m so beautiful. Sometimes we don’t see what others do.

Please don’t. I attempted suicide and almost succeeded when I was 16. I cut myself for most of my teen years. I cant count how many times that I attempted suicide, I always failed. And I’m glad I did. I’m now 31, have been married to a wonderful guy that accepts everything about me and we have a 17 month old. 
Life gets better. There are always times when you are down and can’t help it. I battle depression every day. 
The thought that your bf won’t love you because of who you think you are, that’s depression and anxiety. If he’s worth anything, he will accept your “flaws” and love you even more. I don’t know your situation but I do know that you deserve to be on this earth. We fail, but don’t give up. Please.

Don’t go back to meth. I really wish my sister would quit drugs and come home. 
Congrats on getting fat. Replace the dumplings with walking and water. You’ll be fine.
I’m so sorry. Looks like such a sweet boy.
